Class RearrangeEvent

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.net.events.clientevents.ClientEvent
it.polimi.ingsw.net.events.clientevents.cardevents.RearrangeEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class RearrangeEvent extends ClientEvent
Represents an event triggered by a client when requesting a rearrangement action. This event encapsulates information regarding the coordinates of the initial and final positions of a load, as well as the internal positions and a player's decision to stop or continue the rearrangement process
